name: MovieCat
subtitle: Your movie & TV file library
promotionalText: Point MovieCat at your movie folders and instantly see posters, ratings and summaries for every film and show. No account or API key needed.
description:
MovieCat turns folders full of video files into a beautiful, browsable movie library.

Point it at your movie and TV folders, or let it find them for you, and MovieCat recognises each title from its file name, even messy release names like "The.Matrix.1999.1080p.BluRay.x264". It then shows the poster, rating, year, genres, runtime and a short summary.

FEATURES
• Works instantly: no account, no sign-up, no API key
• Recognises movies and TV episodes from file names, including season/episode numbers and foreign titles
• Groups TV episodes by show
• Find movies automatically: searches the folders you choose and skips home videos, screen recordings and tutorials
• Rate titles yourself with 1 to 10 stars
• Search, filter (Movies, TV, Unrecognised) and sort by title, year or rating
• Fix a wrong match in seconds
• Play a file or show it in Finder with one click
• Optional free TMDB key for even better matching

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
MovieCat has no account and collects no data. Your library stays on your Mac; only titles are sent to public movie databases to look them up.

MovieCat is not affiliated with IMDb. TV data from TVmaze. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
reviewNotes:
MovieCat organises the user's own video files; no login is needed.

How to test:
1. Launch and click "Get started" (the TMDB key is optional, skip it).
2. Click "Add folder" and choose a folder with video files. Empty placeholder files work, e.g. create files named "Big.Buck.Bunny.2008.mkv", "Sintel.2010.mkv" and "Night.of.the.Living.Dead.1968.mkv".
3. Titles are identified from the file names and shown with poster, rating and summary. Click a poster for details.

"Find movies automatically" first asks which folders to search (App Sandbox), then proposes folders that contain recognised movies.

Metadata comes from public services: IMDb search suggestions, Cinemeta and TVmaze. The red banner in the top-right corner links to our other app, ABCx3, on the Mac App Store.
